grammar_focus: KS9/33/57 介词综合(教材 L81 Key structures,方案B换情节包):at(时间点/地点一点:at ten o'clock / at the door / at noon)、in(在…里面/穿着:in the city center / in a uniform / in the afternoon)、to(方向:go to / return to)、with(伴随/工具/方式:with our tickets / with great care / with surprising speed)、into(进入:led us into / walked into)
scene: 周六,我们去了市中心的科学博物馆。我们十点到达,拿着票在门口等候。一位穿蓝色制服的讲解员把我们带进了第一个大厅。她非常小心地给我们展示了各种旧机器的模型。在一个房间里,一个机器人以惊人的速度移动着。我们站在前面,惊讶地看着它。中午,我们坐在咖啡馆里,聊着看到的东西。下午,我们兴奋地走进了太空展区。我们在博物馆一直待到五点闭馆。在回家的路上,我们商量着要和朋友们再来一次。

grammar_card.title: KS9/33/57 介词综合 at / in / to / with / into
grammar_card.intro: 常用介词各有分工:①at——具体时间点或一个“点”状的地点(at ten o'clock / at the door / at noon);②in——在某个空间“里面”或“穿着”(in the city center / in a blue uniform / in the afternoon);③to——朝某处“去、到”的方向(go to / return to);④with——“带着、用、以某种方式”(with our tickets / with great care / with surprising speed);⑤into——从外“进入”里面(led us into the hall / walked into the section)。

rows: at ten o'clock / at the door / at noon
in the city center / in a uniform / in the afternoon
went to the museum / returned to the entrance
with our tickets / with great care / with speed
led us into the hall / walked into the section

specialRules.rule: 美语里“电梯”说 elevator(英式 lift)、“市中心”说 downtown(英式 city centre)、“洗手间”说 restroom(英式 toilet);本课已按美语写。
in 表“在里面/静止的位置”,into 表“从外到里的动作”:be in the hall(在大厅里)vs walk into the hall(走进大厅)。别混。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Where did they go on Saturday?
options: To the science museum in the city center

passage: On Saturday we went to the science museum in the city center. We arrived at ten o'clock and waited at the door with our tickets. A guide in a blue uniform led us into the first hall. With great care, she showed us models of old machines. In one room, a robot moved with surprising speed. We stood at the front and looked at it with amazement. At noon we sat in the café and talked about what we had seen. In the afternoon we walked into the space section with excitement. We stayed at the museum until it closed at five. On the way home, we talked about coming back with our friends.
